title: Merged Bug Fix — Flutter Mobile
description: Fixed a duplicate login page bug caused by Android's singleTask warm-start behavior: when an unauthenticated user triggered a share intent while the app was backgrounded, auto_route stacked a second login page behind the splash screen's replacement. Resolved by replacing replaceRoute(LoginRoute()) with context.router.replaceAll([LoginRoute()]) to clear the entire navigation stack, ensuring a single login page regardless of prior stack state.

title: Bottom Sheet Padding Fix in Multiselect Mode
description: Fixing an issue where the selection bottom sheet overlaps images in multiselect mode on mobile. Replacing a hardcoded padding value with a solution that dynamically measures the sheet header at runtime, keeping the sheet's resting size and the timeline grid's bottom padding in sync regardless of content, rotation, or text scaling.
